args.query: generate PDF invoice from an HTML Jinja2 template with WeasyPrint

results.title: Jinja2 sandboxed email templates with autoescape and custom filters
results.summary: A Jinja2 environment with FileSystemLoader, per-extension autoescape, StrictUndefined, custom filters returning Markup, and a sandbox, tested offline against temporary templates.

results.title: FastAPI Jinja2 full pages vs HTMX partials via HX-Request
results.summary: Serve a full HTML page to normal browsers and a bare HTML fragment to HTMX requests, chosen by the HX-Request header, with Vary set for caches. Tested offline with the sync TestClient.

results.title: Jinja2 SandboxedEnvironment for untrusted user templates
results.summary: Render untrusted user templates with a hardened sandbox: allowlisted globals, an immutable context, strict undefined handling and an output size cap.

results.title: pdf-lib create and read invoice PDF
results.summary: Build a multi-page invoice PDF with pdf-lib, draw text and rectangles, then reload the bytes and assert page count offline.

results.title: pdfkit generate PDF
results.summary: Build a PDFDocument with pdfkit, stream it into a buffer, and assert the output starts with %PDF using only built-in fonts offline.

results.title: Mako template inheritance, defs and HTML escaping
results.summary: Load Mako templates from an in-memory TemplateLookup, inherit a base layout, call defs and apply filters with safe HTML escaping by default.

results.title: mjml to html
results.summary: Render MJML markup to responsive HTML email with mjml2html, asserting expected text and inlined styles, running validation in soft mode and inspecting the errors array for intentionally broken markup.

results.title: React Email template rendered to HTML and plain text
results.summary: Build a transactional email with @react-email/components (preview, rows/columns, button, link) in TSX and render both the HTML document and the plain-text version with @react-email/render, checking escaping offline.

results.title: node-html-parser query and mutate
results.summary: Parse an HTML fixture with node-html-parser, query nodes via CSS selectors, read text and attributes, mutate with set_content, setAttribute and remove, then serialize back and assert the result offline.

results.title: fpdf2 multi-page PDF table with repeated headers and page numbers
results.summary: Build a table that flows across pages with fpdf2, repeat the heading row on every page and stamp Page X/N footers, then assert on the rendered output offline.
